name: Yadokari Typhoon!
source:
Main character Ricardo is a captain of a pirate ship. His crew is full of energy in search of riches. The jewel stuck in the ship deck hints a way to the legendary pirate paradise with tons of gems. All directions are available for new adventures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公里卡多是一艘海盗船的船长。船员们精力充沛地寻找财富。嵌在甲板上的宝石暗示了通往传说中遍地宝石的海盗乐园之路。新的冒险在各个方向等待着他们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
